questions.question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

________ of the two boys turned up the next day.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"neither"** is used to indicate that none of the two boys turned up the next day.
 
• "But" is a conjunction used to introduce a contrasting statement, which is not appropriate here.
 
• "Not" is an adverb and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• "Every" is used with singular nouns to refer to all the individual members of a group, which is not suitable in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**Neither** of the two boys turned up the next day."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **But:** This option introduces a contrast and is not suitable for the blank.
 
• **Not:** This option is grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• **Every:** This option is grammatically incorrect and does not fit the context.

questions.question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I __has mailed__ you the invoice.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the** incorrect use of the verb** **"has" with "I."**
 
• The correct auxiliary verb to use with **"I" is "will."**
 
• Also, the verb** "mail"** should be in its base form when used with **"will."**
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be** "I will mail you the invoice."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I **will mail **you the invoice."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "has mail" is incorrect because the verb should match the subject "I."
 
• **Option 2:** "No improvement" is incorrect because the sentence contains a grammatical error.
 
• **Option 3:** "will mailed" is incorrect because "mailed" should be in its base form "mail."
 
• **Option 4:** "will mail" is correct and aligns with the subject "I."

questions.question:

__
 
• The word **"Abundance"** means a very large quantity of something. (प्रचुरता)

 
 
• **Example: **There was an** abundance **of food at the festival, enough to feed everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Scanty" **refers to something that is insufficient in quantity or amount; not enough. (अल्प)
 
 
• **Example: **The rainfall this year has been **scanty,** leading to concerns about water shortages.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Abundance' **is **'Scanty'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Endemic** (स्थानिक): Regularly found among particular people or in a certain area.

 
 
• **Example:** Malaria is endemic in many tropical regions.
 
 
 
• **Deluge** (प्रलय): A severe flood or an overwhelming amount of something.
 
 
• **Example: **After the drought, the region experienced a deluge that caused widespread damage.
 
 
 
• **Epidemic** (महामारी): A widespread occurrence of an infectious disease in a community at a particular time.
 
 
• **Example:** The flu epidemic of 1918 had devastating effects worldwide.
